description: This file defines an interface for S3 bucket ARNs within the AWS SDK for PHP, extending a generic ARN interface and including a method to retrieve the bucket name.

classes.name: BucketArnInterface
classes.description: An interface representing Amazon S3 Bucket ARNs, providing a method to get the bucket name.

methods.name: getBucketName
methods.description: Returns the name of the S3 bucket associated with this ARN.
